gen-gf-grandstander-archivo: Grandstander draws bold, expressive letters with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Archivo adds a sans-serif body whose curves open outward, so the two feel loud but friendly in each other's company.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-merriweather-sans: A c that nearly seals itself shut gives Groovy its funky, loosely tracked look. Merriweather Sans brings sturdy, tall lowercase in sans-serif, and its open e makes the closed heading feel lively by comparison.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-supreme: Wide, friendly and floating, with letters that never crowd. Nasalization is best at spacious, round-bowled letters, while Supreme is a crisp sans that holds a dense, heavy band of text.
gen-dafont-nordic-manrope: Brush-dab spacing and cramped openings give Nordic its ancient feel. Nordic is strongest at powerful, tightly closed shapes, while Manrope is best at bright, open curves that feel approachable.
gen-gf-gugi-archivo: Lowercase that nearly climbs to capital height defines Gugi. Archivo, a sans with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height, gives that bold display a grounded, editorial partner on the page.
gen-eater-fs-public-sans: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems and wide gaps between every letter. Public Sans, a sans-serif, feels sturdy and trustworthy beside all that menace.
gen-gf-grandstander-switzer: Expressive letters with a showman's grin, drawn in constant-width lines. Grandstander does best with short ascenders and a tall x-height, while Switzer prefers tubular, wire-like letterforms with a tall waist line.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-asap: Ascenders barely clear the x-height in Love Ya Like A Sister. Its r, n and m keep arches matching their stems, while Asap, a readable sans, offers open c arcs and a body height near the capitals.
gen-dafont-dogica-satoshi: Dogica sits heavy and commanding, with lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Satoshi, a sans with uniform strokes and a soaring x-height, would read smoothly and approachably across many lines of text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-archivo: Archivo, a sans, reads in a confident, editorial way. Metamorphous brings wide sidebearings, a high midline and soft, etched-glass weight shifts up top, while Archivo's commanding x-height holds its own just beneath.
